title: MicroSims 101 Course Schedule (fictional sample data)
note: Invented events for teaching the timeline template's JSON event format. Not real history.

text.headline: Course idea proposed
text.text: A teacher proposes a short course on building MicroSims. Only the year is known, so the event has no month or day.

events.notes: Year-only date: the script treats the missing month and day as January 1.

text.headline: Learning graph drafted
text.text: The course team drafts the learning graph of concepts and their dependencies during September.

events.notes: Year and month: "month": "9" is September, placed on the 1st.

text.headline: Syllabus approved
text.text: The curriculum committee approves the syllabus and the chapter list on January 12.

events.notes: Full date: month 1 (January) becomes Date month 0.

text.headline: Pilot section begins
text.text: The first pilot section of the course starts in February with twenty volunteer teachers.

events.notes: Year and month only: shown on February 1.

text.headline: Midterm MicroSim lab
text.text: Learners build their first instrumented MicroSim in a two-hour lab on March 16.

events.notes: Full date: "month": "3" is March; the script passes 2 to new Date().

text.headline: Final project due
text.text: Each learner submits a MicroSim portfolio with a specification, the sim and its metadata by May 8.

text.headline: Course evaluation survey
text.text: Learners and teachers answer the end-of-course evaluation survey during June.

events.notes: Year and month only: shown on June 1.

text.headline: Course opens to all
text.text: After revisions from the pilot, the course is offered to every teacher in the district.
